releases.body:
OpenCode Desktop usage, quota, TPS/TTFT and session stats sidebar.

## Install

npm:
`jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-usage-desktop"]
}
`

GitHub:
`jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["github:sthsmall/opencode-usage-desktop"]
}
`

## Features
- OpenCode Go / Zen quota with used/remaining, pace, thresholds and notifications
- Live TPS, 15-minute minute-level chart, 24h/30d TPS and TTFT history
- Session cards: cost, tokens, cache read/write, cache hit, context, reasoning share, cost per 1M
- Stats dialog: token activity, token mix, efficiency, project scope, tool detail, model breakdown
- Settings, commands, and system notifications
